@metadata.comment: Notes for translators of the website's own pages. Plot Device is the app's name: keep it in Latin letters. Never call Plot Device free (no cost), except in support-cost.

nav-why: Link in the site's header and footer to the front page, which explains what Plot Device is for.
nav-guide: Link in the site's header and footer to the user guide.
nav-support: Link in the site's header and footer to the page about supporting Plot Device.
nav-languages: Link in the site's footer to the page listing Plot Device's languages, where a visitor can ask for theirs.
nav-label: Accessible name of the site's footer navigation; read by screen readers, not shown.
footer-credits: Link in the site's footer to the guide's credits and licence page.
footer-problem: Link in the site's footer to the guide page on reporting a problem.
footer-made-by:
Line at the bottom of every page.

Parameters:
* $1 - the maker's name, Moriel Schottlender, as a link to moriel.tech (not translated).
footer-language: Label before the links to the same page in other languages, in the site's footer. Each language's link shows its own name, such as English or עברית.
choose-language-title: Heading of the page at the site's root address, shown only when the browser's language couldn't choose English or Hebrew. Usually the app's name, untranslated.
choose-language-lede: One line under the heading of the root page that offers a choice of language.
home-title: The front page's title, shown in the browser tab and in search results.
home-description: The front page's description, shown in search results and link previews.
hero-title: The front page's main heading: the promise of Plot Device in a few words.
hero-lede: The line under the front page's main heading.
download: Main button on the front page; goes to the page where Plot Device's installers are downloaded.
read-guide: Button beside Download on the front page; opens the user guide.
platforms: Small line under the Download button: which operating systems the early versions are for.
hero-shot-alt: Description of the front page's large screenshot, for screen readers. The Salt Orchard is the sample novel shown; use its name in your language's sample if it has one.
write-eyebrow: Small capitals label above a section of the front page about writing without setup.
write-title: Heading of the front page's section about writing without setup.
write-text: Text of the front page's section about writing without setup.
write-alt: Description of the screenshot beside the writing section, for screen readers.
story-eyebrow: Small capitals label above the front page's section about outlines.
story-title: Heading of the front page's section about outlines.
story-text: Text of the front page's section about outlines (board, list, text).
story-alt: Description of the outline board screenshot, for screen readers.
timeline-eyebrow: Small capitals label above the front page's section about the timeline.
timeline-title: Heading of the front page's section about the timeline of storylines.
timeline-text: Text of the front page's section about the timeline.
timeline-alt: Description of the timeline screenshot, for screen readers. Bea and Ilka are characters of the sample novel.
references-eyebrow: Small capitals label above the front page's section about characters and places beside the page.
references-title: Heading of the front page's section about the references shelf.
references-text: Text of the front page's section about the references shelf.
references-alt: Description of the references shelf screenshot, for screen readers.
bilingual-eyebrow: Small capitals label above the front page's section about Hebrew and English.
bilingual-title: Heading of the front page's section about writing in Hebrew and English.
bilingual-text: Text of the front page's section about mixed Hebrew and English writing.
bilingual-alt: Description of the bilingual screenshot, for screen readers. In the Hebrew site the screenshot is the reverse: an English chapter in the Hebrew interface.
bilingual-more: Link under the Hebrew and English section to the page about Plot Device's languages.
files-eyebrow: Small capitals label above the front page's section about the book's files.
files-title: Heading of the front page's section about the book being a folder of Markdown files.
files-text: Text of the front page's section about the book's files. Obsidian and git are product names.
yours-eyebrow: Small capitals label above the front page's section about privacy and ownership.
yours-title: Heading of the front page's section about privacy and ownership.
yours-text: Text of the front page's section about privacy and ownership.
closing-title: Heading of the front page's closing section, above the Download button.
closing-support:
Quiet line under the front page's closing buttons.

Parameters:
* $1 - a link, with the text of closing-support-link, to the support page.
closing-support-link: Text of the link inside closing-support; goes to the support page.
support-title: Title and main heading of the page about supporting Plot Device.
support-description: The support page's description, shown in search results and link previews.
support-lede: Opening line of the support page: who makes Plot Device and for whom.
support-cost: The one place the site may say Plot Device costs nothing to use (owner's decision): free to use, not free to make. Keep it warm and without guilt.
support-makes-title: Heading of the support page's list of what support makes possible.
support-makes-time: Item in the list of what support makes possible.
support-makes-mac: Item in the list of what support makes possible: a Mac version needs a paid Apple developer account.
support-makes-languages: Item in the list of what support makes possible.
support-makes-calm: Item in the list of what support makes possible: keeping Plot Device without ads, accounts or data collection.
support-ways-title: Heading of the support page's list of ways to help.
support-coffee-title: Heading of the card about giving through Buy Me a Coffee. Buy Me a Coffee is a service's name.
support-coffee-text: Text of the card about giving through Buy Me a Coffee.
support-coffee-button: Button that opens Plot Device's maker's page on Buy Me a Coffee (a service's name, not translated).
support-tell-title: Heading of the card about recommending Plot Device to other writers.
support-tell-text: Text of the card about recommending Plot Device to other writers.
support-report-title: Heading of the card about reporting problems.
support-report-text: Text of the card about reporting problems.
support-report-link: Link in the card about reporting problems; opens the guide's page on how to report one.
support-translate-title: Heading of the card about languages: asking for one, or translating.
support-translate-text: Text of the card about languages.
support-translate-link: Link in the card about languages; opens the languages page.
support-no-pressure: Closing line of the support page: support is never expected.
languages-title: Title and main heading of the page about Plot Device's languages.
languages-description: The languages page's description, shown in search results and link previews.
languages-lede: Opening line of the languages page.
languages-today-title: Heading of the section listing the languages Plot Device speaks now.
languages-today-text: Line before the list of languages; each language is listed by its own name.
languages-today-book: Note under the list of languages: the book's language and the interface's are separate.
languages-ask-title: Heading of the section with the form for asking for a language.
languages-ask-text: Text above the form for asking for a language.
languages-form-language: Label of the form's field for the language the visitor wants.
languages-form-language-hint: Hint under the language field. The examples are language names, written as speakers of each would look for them; adapt them for your readers.
languages-form-email: Label of the form's optional email address field.
languages-form-email-hint: Hint under the email field: what the address is used for, and that nothing else is sent.
languages-form-note: Label of the form's optional free-text field.
languages-form-trap: Label of a hidden field that catches spam robots. People never see it, but screen readers in some setups may; it asks them to leave it empty.
languages-form-send: Button that sends the form asking for a language.
languages-translate-title: Heading of the section about helping translate Plot Device.
languages-translate-text: Text of the section about helping translate.
languages-translate-link: Link to the guide's page on translating Plot Device.
thanks-title: Title and heading of the page shown after the language request is sent.
thanks-description: Description of the thank-you page, for search results (the page isn't meant to be found).
thanks-text: Text of the page shown after the language request is sent.
thanks-back: Link from the thank-you page back to the front page.
